title: Rolls na kwakwa, burodin ayaba da buhunan dutse daga ƙaramin tanda
course_title: Baking Basic Production & Abun ciye-ciye: Hannun-A Kan Kananan Batches Na Siyarwa

say: Rolls na kwakwa, burodin ayaba da buhunan dutse daga ƙaramin tanda.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don ƙirar 3 na Ƙirƙirar Gasa da Abun ciye-ciye.

Gurasar kwakwa tana amfani da kwakwar gida mai arha kuma ana sayar da ita sosai. A hada kwakwa da ruwan dumi sannan a matse kamar 300 ml na madara. Sabbin nonon kwakwa yana lalacewa da sauri, don haka a yi amfani da shi cikin ƴan sa'o'i kaɗan.

panel.heading: Biredi na kwakwa
items: Fresh nono kwakwa, yi wannan rana
Knead minti 10 zuwa 12: gwajin fane
Tabbatar har sai an ninka sau biyu, kamar awa 1
Auna kuma raba cikin guda 12 na 80 g
Na biyu tabbatar, sa'an nan kuma gasa a 180 zuwa 190 digiri
Ƙarƙashin famfo a ƙasa yana nufin an toya shi

say: Mix da kullu kuma a kwaba shi tsawon minti 10 zuwa 12. Miƙa ɗan ƙaramin yanki: idan ya yi sirara don barin haske ya wuce ba tare da yage ba, a shirye yake. Wato gwajin fane na taga.

say: Don ƙarin, kar a yi tsammani. Alal misali, Efe a Warri yana da oda don 30 rolls na 80 g. Wato 2,400 g na kullu.

say: Ayaba masu launin baki suna da arha kuma cikakke: cikakke, mafi dadi. Karɓi kowane mai yumbu ko ƙamshi mai ƙyalƙyali. A auna ayaba da aka bare, domin kirgawa yana ba da burodin da ba daidai ba.

left: Ya dace da iyalai da kyaututtuka
Yana daɗe ba a yanke ba
right: Ya dace da cafes da shagunan tuck
Mafi girman samun kuɗi a kowane burodi
Yana bushewa ko gyaggyarawa da sauri

say: Yanke sau da yawa suna samun ƙarin kowane burodi. Misali, Yetunde a Abeokuta yana ba da wurin shan kofi da yanka 30 duk ranar Juma’a: biredi uku na yanka 10. A yi sanyi gaba ɗaya, a yanka daidai kuma ku nannade kowanne. Idan kun ƙara goro, faɗi haka akan lakabin.

say: Don buns na dutse, shafa margarine mai sanyi a cikin gari kuma a yi kullu mai tauri. Sanya tulin tudu akan tire kuma kar a yi musu santsi. Margarine mai dumi ko jikakken kullu yana sanya su shimfiɗa.

panel.heading: Rock buns da alawar kwakwa
right: Sugar dafa shi zuwa haske amber

say: Don alewa kwakwa, sai a narke sukari a cikin ruwa, sannan a daina motsawa a bar shi ya tafasa. A cikin amber mai haske, ƙara kwakwa, motsawa, da kuma ɗauko ƙananan guda tare da cokali biyu. Misali, Grace a Calabar tana yin duka daga kwakwa ɗaya: abubuwa 42 don rumfarta.

panel.heading: Rock buns da alawar kwakwa

say: Dafa abinci yana da zafi fiye da tafasasshen ruwa, kuma yana manne da fata. Saka dogon hannun riga, a yi amfani da cokali mai dogon hannu, kuma a hana yara waje.

cards.d: Dogayen hannu, cokali mai dogon hannu, yara daga kicin.
Kada ku taɓa dandana daga tukunyar. Kada a taba cakuda har sai ya yi sanyi.
Cool a ƙarƙashin ruwa mai gudu na minti 20. Babu man shanu, mai ko man goge baki. Kada ku kware da sukari.

say: Kada ku ɗanɗana daga tukunyar, kuma kada ku yi amfani da yatsun ku don surar ta.

say: Idan sukari mai zafi ya taɓa fata, sanyaya shi ƙarƙashin ruwan gudu mai sanyi na minti 20. Kar a kware sukarin da ya makale, kuma kar a sanya man shanu, mai, man goge baki ko danyen kwai a kan kuna. Samun taimakon likita don manyan kuna.

say: Don tunawa. Knead zuwa gwajin faifan taga kuma raba ta nauyi. Sikeli ta jimlar nauyin kullu. Ninka bawon ayaba a hankali. A kwantar da komai kafin yin jaka. Kuma kula da sukari mai zafi tare da kulawa sosai. Fresh kwakwa yana gajarta rayuwa, don haka sayar da sauri.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Gwajin Windowpane, sannan raba kullu da nauyi
Sikeli ta jimlar nauyin kullu, taso
Ninka bawon ayaba kawai sai a hade
Yi sanyi gaba daya kafin yin jaka ko slicing
Sugar zafi: hannun riga, cokali, ba yatsu

say: Yanzu yi aiki. A gasa dunƙule na kwakwa da kuma fitar da adadinsu har guda 45. A gasa a yayyanka burodin ayaba a ajiye log ɗin kwana 4. Sannan a yi rowa da alewar kwakwa daga kwakwa daya.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Gasa da auna juzu'in nadi na kwakwa
A gasa da yankakken burodin ayaba
Yi dutsen buns da alewa daga kwakwa ɗaya
